info.title: bmo-voice
info.description: The voice engine: trained voices, speech synthesis on the voice servers of the nodes, transcription, speaker encodings and scripts for the ear. A synthesis is answered at once and the sound follows. Bodies are JSON with camelCase keys, times are integers of epoch milliseconds and spans of milliseconds end in Ms. A list is a page, `after` being the last member's name. Every failure is a non-2xx answer whose body is `code` and `error`. The harness plugin's tools, each a thin call of one route, are stated under `x-tools`. A briefing is a line spoken for a room, kept with the room and the line its caller names and told on the event stream for its listeners to play; when one is spoken, and what it says, is its caller's decision.

x-harness.entry: A harness turns text into speech with voice_synthesize in a voice voice_voices lists, and reads the sound when voice_synthesis says it is done.
